title: Ukrainian Civil War
summary: The term 'Ukrainian Civil War' encompasses several significant conflicts in Ukraine's history, primarily during the early 20th century. These conflicts played a crucial role in shaping Ukraine's national identity and political landscape.

sections.heading: Ukrainian War of Independence (1917–21)
paragraphs: The [[ukrainian-war-of-independence|Ukrainian War of Independence]] occurred from 1917 to 1921, marking a pivotal struggle for [[ukraine|Ukraine]]'s sovereignty following the collapse of the Russian Empire. This conflict involved various factions vying for control and recognition of an independent [[ukrainian-state|Ukrainian state]].

sections.heading: Ukrainian–Soviet War (1917–21)
paragraphs: The [[ukrainiansoviet-war|Ukrainian–Soviet War]], also taking place from 1917 to 1921, was characterized by the conflict between [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] national forces and the Bolshevik government. This war was integral to the broader context of the Russian Civil War and had lasting implications for Ukraine's political future.

sections.heading: Anti-Hetman Uprising (1918)
paragraphs: The Anti-[[hetman|Hetman]] Uprising of 1918 was a significant revolt against the [[hetmanate|Hetmanate]], a regime established [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]] during the War of Independence. This uprising reflected the ongoing struggle for democratic governance and national self-determination in Ukraine during a tumultuous period.

sections.heading: Related Conflicts
paragraphs: The Ukrainian Civil War is also related to various other conflicts in Ukraine's history, including a list of wars involving Ukraine and instances of invasions and occupations that have shaped its territorial and political boundaries.
